recipe_version.title: Greek Gigantes Plaki: Baked Giant Beans in Tomato and Dill
recipe_version.description: Giant white beans baked in a thick tomato sauce with onion, carrot, celery, garlic, dill, and parsley until the top caramelizes at the edges. Served warm with crusty bread and a simple cucumber salad.

ingredients.name: canned or jarred giant white beans
ingredients.display_name: 24-oz jars giant white beans (gigantes) or large lima beans

ingredients.name: crusty bread
ingredients.display_name: crusty bread whose label lists no milk, butter, egg, or honey
ingredients.note: store-bought; required: the ingredient list shows no milk, butter, egg, honey, soy, or sesame

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Drain and rinse the beans. Chop the onion, dice the carrot and celery, mince the garlic, and chop the dill and parsley. Slice the cucumber and red onion.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 375 F. Heat 4 tbsp olive oil in a 12-inch oven-safe skillet over medium. Cook the onion, carrot, and celery until soft, about 8 minutes; add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Add the crushed tomatoes, 1/2 cup water, 1 tsp oregano, and 1 1/2 tsp salt to the skillet and simmer 6 minutes. Fold in the beans, dill, and most of the parsley, then drizzle the top with 2 tbsp olive oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake uncovered until thick, bubbling, and caramelized at the edges, about 35 minutes. Rest 5 minutes.

steps.title: Make the salad
steps.body: While the beans bake, toss the cucumber and red onion with the vinegar, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp oregano, and 1/4 tsp salt (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Scatter the remaining parsley over the beans and serve warm with the cucumber salad and bread.
